quote: Where the signal is a steady red with a green turn arrow: Pedestrians facing such a signal shall not enter the highway, unless permitted to proceed by another device as provided in NRS 484B.283 [NRS-484B-283-1d1, NRS-484B-283-1d2, NRS-484B-283-1d3, NRS-484B-283-1d4].

activation.description: Pedestrian faces a steady-red signal with a green turn arrow.
activation.source_clause: Where the signal is a steady red with a green turn arrow

obligation.description: Facing pedestrian shall not enter the highway unless the cited other-device exception applies.
obligation.source_clause: Pedestrians facing such a signal shall not enter the highway

exceptions.source_clause: unless permitted to proceed by another device as provided in NRS 484B.283
exceptions.trigger: Another device under NRS 484B.283 permits proceeding.
exceptions.effect: The road-entry prohibition is conditional on that permission.
exceptions.replacement_obligation: Retain the other-device direction for independent review.

timing.description: Assess facing indication and other-device direction at first road entry.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: unless permitted to proceed by another device as provided in NRS 484B.283
judgment_calls_needed.note: Whether another official device permits the facing pedestrian to proceed requires original indication, facing and governance review.
